steps.content: The scene before you remains a carefree "stage," where the warm overhead lights mimic the sun, shining on everyone, breathing life into their movements and existence.
The bakery bustles with noise, horns blare on the streets, and "performers" flit amidst it all, as though this place is their natural habitat.

steps.speaker: The Girl Next Door
steps.content: Oh no! My clothes!
A girl, who was hanging laundry up on her balcony, races down the stairs frantically, attempting to retrieve her falling clothes.
You jump and grab the white shirt, swiftly covering the ground towards the girl in big, hurried steps.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Excuse me, are you staff here? I've lost track of my friend. Could I use the PA system, maybe? Or do you happen to know where the backstage is?
Clutching the shirt, you quickly ask your question. The girl grabs the shirt back, giving you a strange look.

steps.speaker: The Girl Next Door
steps.content: What are you even saying? I can't make heads or tails of it! Who are you, acting all weird...?
The girl dashes away from you as if dodging a curse, forcing you to seek out another person.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Pardon me, could you tell me how to exit the stage?

steps.speaker: The Elder
steps.content: Stacy? Has Stacy not come back home yet...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Oh no, I mean, not Stacy... I'm trying to ask, do you know where I can find the crew? I need to speak with someone on the staff...

steps.speaker: The Elder
steps.content: Oh Stan, it's high time you hunted for a job, instead of roaming around aimlessly all day...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I'm not Stan...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, I'll go ask around elsewhere, my apologies.
You move on from the elder, pressing ahead.

Sweat trickles down your forehead as you take a deep breath, steadying your restless mind. You intend to find a young person to ask again, but your attention is suddenly caught by a figure slipping out from behind a curtain.
It's the same chef you encountered before.
But where he just came out of wasn't his bakery, nor a setting.
Your heart races suddenly, a flash of recognition—you think you know where that place is.
...Is it backstage?!
You make a beeline for the chef, itching to get offstage and get a crew member on the line to reach your friends. But suddenly, you're stopped in your tracks!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Move aside, please! I've got to get offstage, there's an urgent situation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let go of me, now!
Grinding your teeth, you hang onto the last bit of your composure. But the chef? He appears totally blind to your rage—it's hard to tell if he's just unaware or deliberately ignoring it.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: What?! You got the nerve to come back here?
The chef ignored your question and asked you in surprise.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Hey, over here! I'm certain of it! His face wasn't in any of the press conference photos! He's no innocent bystander! He's a troublemaker who bolted in the confusion!!
steps.female_content: Hey, over here! I'm certain of it! Her face wasn't in any of the press conference photos! She's no innocent bystander! She's a troublemaker who bolted in the confusion!!

steps.content: The streets are swarming with people now, glaring menacingly, trying to force you out.
The more you move away from the curtain that could be your exit, the more your mind fills with irritation and rage. It's almost like you can hear a voice whispering in your ear:
Turn into the person you've always wanted to be... Live the life you've always dreamed of...

You fight to keep your wits about you, noting that Mania is swaying everyone onstage. It's futile to talk to those absorbed into the script by its influence; try discussing anything off-script, and they'll forcefully drag you into their narrative.
Or in another case, they'll treat you as an anomaly, a villain to be chased away.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't even try... Don't try to hold me back!

You forcefully push through the crowd, but they keep closing in, cornering you at the edge of the "stage." Staring into the pitch-black expanse of the upper seating area, you look for an escape and notice a single lit box shining amidst the darkness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Spectator... There are other spectators here?
You yell towards the area, seeking assistance, but instead of a spectator, the person who steps out of the box is none other than the theater's owner—Lady Pearl.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Lady Pearl?! Please, tell them to stop!
You plead loudly. However, the woman perched above merely cracks a small smile, observing your frantic efforts for a moment before nonchalantly returning to her box.
It dawns on you immediately—this chaos, it must be Lady Pearl's handiwork.
Once this sinks in, you recognize there's no one else to turn to; you have to handle this on your own.
Once you've somewhat settled your scrambled thoughts and emotions, you spot an opening in the furious mob and slip away.
They're hot on your heels. In a rush, you notice a cluttered spot close by and swiftly duck behind it for cover.
Sigh, this world... is in table... oh, it's truly... Uh... no, it's a world in turmoil...
In a world mired in turmoil, everything's a mess, filled with uproar. Better to turn our ears to the bard who sings tales of history!
A strange sound suddenly comes from the jumble of items behind you.
You can't tell if the person has been touched by Mania, so you keep quiet, watching and waiting to see what happens next.
Ah, kindred spirits of life!
The music sounded, and next to a tiny fire in the corner, the flames dance lightly in response to the music's vibrations.
Behold, the world's sole surviving bard, the illustrious Echo, here to spin you a yarn!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: A hearty thanks to you all for gifting me such an exhilarating tale of pursuit to recount!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Come on! Witness history and compose legends with me!!
